Trade Certificate.comment: US name for a vocational qualification in a skilled trade.

Bachelor.comment: Education stage: the first university degree, as a level name on its own (not “Bachelor of …”).

Master.comment: Education stage: the second university degree, as a level name on its own (not “Master of …”).

Present.comment: Button on an event row: give a talk or presentation at the event. A verb.

Perform.comment: Button on an event row: perform on stage at a festival. A verb.

Appear.comment: Button on an event row: appear on a TV show. A verb.

Speak.comment: Button on an event row: give a talk at a conference. A verb.

Compete.comment: Button on an event row: compete in a pitch competition. A verb.

Demo.comment: Button on an event row: demonstrate your work at an expo. A verb.

Presented.comment: Past tense of the event button 'Present'

Performed.comment: Past tense of the event button 'Perform'

Appeared.comment: Past tense of the event button 'Appear'

Spoke.comment: Past tense of the event button 'Speak'

Competed.comment: Past tense of the event button 'Compete'

Demoed.comment: Past tense of the event button 'Demo'

Standard.comment: Seniority level of the plain version of a job, with no Junior/Senior/Lead prefix | The seniority of a job that is the plain role with no Senior, Lead or Junior in front. Next to labels like Senior and Lead.

Childhood.comment: Life stage, ages 7–10: primary school years.

Teen Years.comment: Life stage, ages 11–17: middle and high school years.

Young Adult.comment: Life stage, ages 18–24: college and early career.

Working Life.comment: Life stage, age 25 and over: the working years.

Inventor.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Working problems out: spotting patterns and breaking a puzzle into steps.

Creator.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Coming up with new ideas and seeing things in fresh ways.

Influencer.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Talking, writing, listening and presenting — getting ideas across so people get them.

Persuader.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Convincing people, negotiating deals and closing a sale.

Leader.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Helping a group decide and act together.

Visionary.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Ambition and initiative: imagining big goals, betting on yourself, and acting before there's a playbook.

Detective.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Catching small mistakes and double-checking everything.

Fixer.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Working steadily and precisely with your hands.

Navigator.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Picturing how shapes, spaces and machines fit together — and finding your way.

Athlete.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Physical stamina — long shifts on your feet, heavy work, and all weathers, indoors or out.

Zen.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Staying calm and thinking clearly under pressure — when a mistake is costly and there's no time.

Empath.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Sensing how others feel and responding with care.

Teamplayer.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Sharing the work and pulling together with others.

Planner.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Organising your days and finishing things on time.

Champion.comment: Name of a skill (ability) the player builds, shown next to a pictogram and used as a playful job-like title. The skill: Sticking with hard work even when it's boring.

Skill.comment: Fallback name for a soft skill that has no label | Fallback name of a soft skill
